note: Barcelona publishes no evacuation routes for street flooding. The municipal plan (PAEM insuficiència drenant) and INUNCAT work by confinement: stay inside, go up, keep out of basements, garages and underpasses, and only leave if 112 or Protecció Civil tell you to. The entries below are the real things a resident can use. Sources in docs/evacuation-research.md.
